review_notes: I read the whole file and looked at its new definitions: pgen, Ow, cst, hatQ, IsCoord, barT and Papprox. I searched Mathlib for competing concepts. Mathlib has no QuaternionAlgebra.map or baseChange, no general nrd or trd, and no tensor-product quaternion conjugation. The only hits were Rat.HeightOneSpectrum.natGenerator in Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics/HeightOneSpectrum.lean, which pgen wraps as an abbrev, and cst, which is just an abbrev for algebraMap. These are named specialisations, not independent competing concepts. The nearest overlaps, hatQ and IsCoord, are close to the project's own Definitions/Def_QuaternionAlgebra_BaseChange.lean (baseChangeRight_tmul). That is not Mathlib, so it is outside this rubric. Several lemmas (nrd_mul', nrd_smul', the 2×2 Cayley–Hamilton identity, mem_Ow_iff versus mem_integers_iff) duplicate theorems, which the rubric excludes. I did not check every Mathlib directory exhaustively, so there is a small chance I missed an equivalent concept.
